title: Commercial hedging-flow acceleration: second-difference states of commercial net positioning as risk-transfer saturation

blindness_declaration.law: This document is authored before anyone measures anything for this lane. It declares a mechanism, a rule FAMILY and a representation identity. It contains no outcome numbers, no returns conditional on states, no expectancies, and no signal arithmetic on positioning or prices beyond the structural facts committed in the P0/P1/P2 artifacts (first and second differences of committed report counts; no price input in any state). All rule parameters are SYMBOLIC and freeze at D2/S selection, never after any scored number.

mechanism.narrative: Commercial hedgers do not trade views; they trade inventory. The weekly change in their net position is the flow of hedge layoff or absorption; the CHANGE IN THAT FLOW - its acceleration, the second difference of commercial net positioning - marks weeks in which the pace of risk transfer between the physical book and the speculative market is itself turning. Two regimes print there: hedge-demand saturation after an extended move (hedgers are already fully hedged, so incremental hedge additions collapse even while the move persists - the forced participant has run out of exposure to lay off), and inventory-shock re-hedging (a physical book change forces rapid hedge adjustment regardless of price level). The FORCED participant is unambiguous: the commercial hedger whose re-hedging pace is set by physical exposure and forward commitments he cannot refuse, re-time, or size at discretion. The LATE participant is the speculator and ETP flow, which adjusts only after the transfer has already saturated - hedging acceleration is visible in the official report one release before speculative participation patterns respond. The declared family conditions on the bucket of the second difference of committed commercial net positioning (symbolic window and symbolic cuts, both tails), arming a state-conditioned position per a frozen sign convention: acceleration collapses (saturation) and acceleration spikes (shock re-hedging) are the two declared conditioning regimes. The claim is that hedge-flow ACCELERATION - an official, position-based quantity that exists even in weeks when price goes nowhere - carries information no price-derived acceleration can: a price acceleration measure is a function of the price path alone and is blind to a hedger whose book changed while price did not. The mandatory price-only shadow (acceleration of price-direction states on the identical clock) is its designated executioner.

forced_participant.who: the commercial hedger, whose weekly hedge adjustment pace follows physical inventory and forward-book exposure rather than opinion
forced_participant.why_forced: hedging is the mechanical shadow of the physical book: exposure changes force hedge changes on the CFTC reporting schedule regardless of price, so the acceleration of commercial net positioning is the footprint of constraint, not of choice - saturation means the exposure available for layoff is exhausted, a spike means the book itself moved
forced_participant.late_participant: speculators and ETP-linked flow, which pattern only after the risk transfer has saturated; they are the liquidity the next hedging wave consumes

mechanism.information_source: official CFTC legacy futures-only reports only (committed P0 structural fields; the state uses first and second differences of comm_long/comm_short net over consecutive PIT-visible reports); no prices in any state
mechanism.state_definition_symbolic: state(t) = tail-bucket of a(r_t), where a(r) = second difference over a symbolic window of ([comm_long - comm_short]) across consecutive PIT-visible reports r; tail cuts c_lo, c_hi and window w are SYMBOLIC, frozen at D2/S, never after; the two tails are the declared regimes (saturation collapse, shock spike); direction convention per frozen symmetric sign declaration; mid-distribution inert
mechanism.q16_instrument_note: the instrument is the ETP leg; weekly-scale holding carries the Q-16 drag bill: transaction component at tier 2.0 once per fill, measured expense accrual over the declared horizon, same-underlying tracking divergence as declared instrument fact (representation_identity.q16_instrument_declaration); the holding window h is symbolic so the drag bill is fixed at D2/S

decision_rule_family: acceleration-conditioning weekly family on the ETP leg: while a(r_t) sits in a symmetric tail bucket of the second difference of committed commercial net positioning, hold a position per the frozen symmetric sign convention for a symbolic holding window h of decision-session closes; otherwise flat; window w, tail cuts c_lo/c_hi and h are SYMBOLIC parameters, frozen at D2/S selection and never tuned after any scored number

ancestry_risk_statement.declaration: This proposal names the pooled kill-candidate shadows it must be novel against (plan section 1; D2 pooled |rho| screen) and states, per shadow, why official positioning information differs. This is the claim D2 will test; if any claim is false, the proposal dies at D2 by the pooled screen or by its own battery.

named_kill_candidates.why_different: the conditioning state is a second difference of OFFICIAL report counts with no price input; it exists and moves in weeks when price is flat, and is flat in strongly trending weeks when the hedging book is stable - a trailing-price momentum form cannot represent either situation. Honest admission: commercial hedging flow is correlated with past price moves (hedges follow inventory built in trends), so if in-sample the acceleration tail selects weeks a price-momentum form selects identically (state rho beyond the frozen ceiling), that is the momentum_63s veto plus the price-only acceleration shadow, and the proposal dies
named_kill_candidates.shadow_class: momentum_63s (generic price momentum; pooled D2 veto set)

named_kill_candidates.why_different: the release clock only timestamps state updates; the acceleration state is inert in mid-distribution weeks, so a fixed-direction weekly clock holds positions this family must be flat in. The release-clock shadow is the designated executioner: if a bare fixed-direction Friday-release clock matches the anchor, the state adds nothing over the calendar geometry and the proposal dies
named_kill_candidates.shadow_class: generic_dow_tue (calendar-clock forms; the CoT release weekday geometry)

named_kill_candidates.why_different: a displacement-fade is a function of a short price move at a daily clock; this family's state is a book-flow acceleration at the weekly release clock with polarity set by the frozen sign convention on the OFFICIAL quantity - hedge-demand saturation can print while price still rises (the fade has already been wrong for weeks there), and shock re-hedging can print with no price displacement at all. The residual risk - that saturation tails coincide with trend exhaustion visible in price - is exactly what the price-only acceleration shadow and the D2 pooled v16 veto must test; if they reproduce the anchor, the proposal dies
named_kill_candidates.shadow_class: v16_close_displace_fade (short-horizon price reversal; pooled D2 veto set)

arms.name: hedging-acceleration arm
arms.spec: the declared rule family: hold a position while a(r_t) sits in a symmetric tail bucket of the second difference of committed commercial net positioning, direction by the frozen symmetric sign convention, symbolic holding window h
arms.kill_semantics: anchor; killed by any designated KILLER control out-earning it (see falsification_rule)

arms.name: price-only acceleration shadow (MANDATORY, plan section 1)
arms.spec: the SAME tradeable rule (same clock, same tail-bucket shape, same symmetric sign convention, same symbolic parameters) with the acceleration coordinate replaced by a price-only analogue: the second difference of the leg's RAW close-to-close direction state over the same window read under the same V7 close+1 convention; NO CoT input whatsoever
arms.kill_semantics: DESIGNATED KILLER: out-earns the anchor => official hedging acceleration adds nothing over price-only acceleration (momentum_63s class) and the proposal dies

arms.name: bare release-clock shadow
arms.spec: identical holding shape and execution, FIXED direction sign, no state: every grid instant pooled (the bare Friday-release weekly clock)
arms.kill_semantics: DESIGNATED KILLER: out-earns the anchor => the state adds nothing over the generic release weekday clock (generic_dow_tue class) and the proposal dies

arms.name: stale-release placebo
arms.spec: the identical state machinery fed reports k release-instants OLDER than the PIT-visible set (k symbolic, >= 4 releases, frozen at selection): preserves weekly clock and marginal acceleration distribution while destroying the release-aligned information; Q-11: too-few-eligible-instant outcomes are invalid/NOT_RUN, never zero
arms.kill_semantics: DESIGNATED KILLER: out-earns the anchor => the effect is release-information-independent and the proposal dies

arms.name: two-delay placement pair
arms.spec: the identical anchor rule at D0 = the P2 later-bound decision session and D1 = the next session after D0; both reported side by side
arms.kill_semantics: diagnostic for clock-placement artifacts; informs the D2 report, does not kill alone

arms.name: clairvoyant ceiling arm (Q-4)
arms.spec: same bucket structure, but tail membership and side granted full-sample knowledge no live PIT process could have; ceiling reference only
arms.kill_semantics: NEVER selectable at S (P-15 smoke kills-never-selects); bounds a perfect oracle of this state; invalid vs null recorded (Q-11)

falsification_rule.statement: KILL if, at D2/I on the identical bookable grid, restricted leg set and window under the identical frozen cost treatment, ANY designated KILLER control (the price-only acceleration shadow, the bare release-clock shadow, or the stale-release placebo) earns a strictly greater after-cost per-decision edge than the ANCHOR arm. The price-only shadow matching the anchor means hedging-flow acceleration reduces to price acceleration (momentum_63s class); the release-clock shadow matching the anchor means the state adds nothing over the release weekday; the stale-release placebo matching the anchor means the release-aligned official flow carries nothing. Declared now, outcome-blind; measurable later from the committed arms alone.
